story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound business dates and populate Eligibility Date for new enrollment before eligibility begins
gaps: TC_006 also requires "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun, the Eligibility Date (DTP*356/DTP*348) populates as the transaction effective date."; add a dedicated test case for it

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date for current eligibility change when Assessment Date changes
gaps: Duplicate intent with TC_001: both validate that the current eligibility change uses the changed Assessment Date as the transaction effective date and that processing completes without errors. TC_006 Expected Result: "The current eligibility update is fully processed, the transaction effective date is correctly populated in Facets from the changed Assessment Date, and no unexpected MELC exception record was created during the run." TC_001 Expected Result: "The AR PASSE current eligibility change is fully processed, the Facets transaction effective date is 2025-06-29 from Loop 2300 HD03, and the update is loaded successfully with no use of Eligibility Date or Maintenance Date for this scenario."

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date and preserve unchanged relevant fields when only Assessment Date changes
Use Eligibility Date for future eligibility change to listed fields when Assessment Date is unchanged
Use Maintenance Date for current eligibility change to listed fields when Assessment Date is unchanged

flagged.why: missing dedicated case for one field

gaps: TC_002 is the closest related case, but scenario coverage is incomplete: scenario description requires "Assessment Number, Assessment Tier, Assessment Division, Aid Category, Rate Cell, Pregnancy" and there is no dedicated test case for "Assessment Number" because the table has test cases only for TC_001 through TC_006 and none beyond TC_006; add a dedicated test case for it

scenarios.title: Regression validation for selective date usage impact on capitation and finance reporting
gaps: TC_001 is the most closely related case, but scenario TS_007 also requires "Confirm that Maintenance Date is only used when specified in acceptance criteria." and the full acceptance text states "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has already begun and any relevant fields have changed but Assessment Date has NOT changed, the Maintenance Date (DTP*303) populates as the transaction effective date."; add a dedicated test case for it

scenarios.title: Use first occurrence when multiple inbound dates of the same type are present
